verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for an experimentation and feature-flag platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows Scheduled Rollouts: a one-off gradual deployment of a single feature gate over time, not a recurring job or workflow schedule. Running the CLI from CI/CD pipelines is a user-side workaround that depends on external schedulers, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
